title: Space Filling Curves is All You Need: Communication-Avoiding Matrix Multiplication Made Simple
abstract: arXiv:2601.16294v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) is the cornerstone of HPC workloads and Deep Learning. State-of-the-art (SOTA) vendor libraries tune tensor layouts, parallelization schemes and cache blocking to minimize data movement across the memory hierarchy and maximize throughput. However, optimal settings for these parameters depend on the target platform and matrix shapes, making exhaustive tuning infeasible. In this work, we address this cumbersome scheduling search and tuning using space-filling curves (SFC). translated_title: 空间填充曲线足矣：让通信避免矩阵乘法变得简单
translated_abstract: 通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）是高性能计算（HPC）工作负载和深度学习的基石。最先进的（SOTA）厂商库通过调整张量布局、并行化方案和缓存分块来最小化跨存储层次结构的数据移动并最大化吞吐量。然而，这些参数的最优设置依赖于目标平台和矩阵形状，使得穷举式调优不可行。在本工作中，我们使用空间填充曲线（SFC）来解决这一繁琐的调度搜索与调优问题。我们利用SFC的最新进展对矩阵乘法进行划分，获得了具有高度数据局部性的平台无关和形状无关的矩阵乘法方案。我们进一步将基于SFC的工作划分以无缝的方式扩展，实现了带有复制技术的通信避免（CA）算法。所得到的SFC-CA GEMM在方形和矩形矩阵上均实现了可证明的渐近通信最优性。
tldr: 本文利用空间填充曲线对矩阵乘法进行划分，实现了平台无关、形状无关且无需繁琐调优的通信避免GEMM算法，并达到可证明的渐近通信最优性。
en_tdlr: This paper partitions matrix multiplication using space-filling curves to achieve platform-oblivious, shape-oblivious communication-avoiding GEMM with provable asymptotic communication optimality, eliminating the need for cumbersome tuning.
